correctness.rationale: For the explicit 12-vertex, 24-edge triangle-free graph, independent finite enumeration gives K=N(G) with face vector (12,42,44,12) and L=Ind(G) with (12,42,52,20). Exactly eight surplus triangles are uniquely free in L, each paired to a distinct surplus tetrahedron, with no other extra faces, and all eight pairs form one free orbit of the exhaustively enumerated 8-element D4 automorphism group. Independently reconstructed greedy face-poset matching on K has 54 disjoint matched incidences, critical masks {1,672}, all 264 cover edges acyclic in a 110-vertex topological sort. Forman gives one 0-cell and one 2-cell, hence S² integrally. Exhaustive graph coloring gives χ=4; signed fixed-face alternating traces on r,s,rs equal (-1,-1,+1), hence orientation degree (-1)^{a+b} over integral H2. Code and source tree verified; finite enumeration is exhaustive for this single graph, not a statement about all graphs.

value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is a canonical extremal triangle-free four-chromatic graph. The exact graph-automorphism-equivariant *relative* inclusion between two fundamental graph complexes is a natural structural question not answered by an abstract Ind(G) sphere calculation. A single free dihedral orbit of elementary collapses explains why the Lovász neighborhood-complex connectivity obstruction is sharp, while the D4 homology orientation character is a natural, symmetry-sensitive exact invariant. The scope is one important fixed finite graph, not a family classification. Its known χ=4 and Ind sphere are not independent gains.
